invariants: Exactly 15 payload variants and 15 kinds, one per destination (resolved 2026-11-26); the destination strings are fixed literals and route_key always uses version 1.
kind() is a pure, faithful classification of the variant (the Payload contract); it never chooses the route - the header does.
category() is a derived grouping only (Read/Control/Decision) for metrics and policy; routing never uses it.
responsibilities: WorkKind: the 15 destination kinds, each with its fixed destination string and its category.
WorkPayload: the request sum the bridge carries; control variants wrap the request structs, read variants carry their fields inline.
The Payload impl and the route_key helper the route registrars use.
summary: The bridge payload: 15 typed destinations with fixed route strings, one kind per destination, and a derived read/control/decision grouping.
